front: In AWS, a database password must rotate automatically on a schedule with the LEAST operational overhead. Which service stores it?
back: AWS Secrets Manager, with automatic rotation.
extra: Credential rotation in Secrets Manager: [Automatic, with native database integrations](../facts/parameter-store.md#parameter-store-vs-secrets-manager-rotation-row).

front: In ACM, can a CloudFront distribution use a certificate that you requested in US West (Oregon)?
back: No. CloudFront uses certificates in US East (N. Virginia).
extra: You request or import the certificate for CloudFront in [US East (N. Virginia)](../facts/acm.md#acm-cloudfront-us-east-1).

front: In Secrets Manager, a deleted secret waits a recovery window of {{c1::from 7 to 30}} days.
In Parameter Store, standard or advanced tier: which one supports parameter policies?
extra: For parameter policies you [use the advanced parameters tier](../facts/parameter-store.md#parameter-store-policies-advanced-only).

front: In Secrets Manager, a secret can rotate as often as {{c1::every four hours}}.
In Parameter Store, a standard parameter value can be at most {{c1::4 KB}}.
In Parameter Store, one account can have up to {{c1::10,000}} standard parameters in each Region.
In Parameter Store, with default throughput, GetParameter, GetParameters and GetParametersByPath share {{c1::40 TPS}} combined.
In ACM, does managed renewal cover a certificate that you imported?
back: No. You renew it and reimport it.
extra: ACM [does not manage the renewal process](../facts/acm.md#acm-faq-imported-no-managed-renewal) for imported certificates. A reimport keeps the [Amazon Resource name (ARN)](../facts/acm.md#acm-reimport-keeps-arn).

front: In Secrets Manager, can another account read a secret that the AWS managed key aws/secretsmanager encrypts?
back: No. Use a customer managed key.
extra: For cross-account access you [can't use the AWS managed key](../facts/secrets-manager.md#secrets-manager-cross-account-no-aws-managed-key). Use [a KMS key that you create](../facts/secrets-manager.md#secrets-manager-cross-account-no-aws-managed-key).

front: In ACM, a web application on EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer needs HTTPS with certificates that renew automatically. Where does the certificate go?
back: On the load balancer's HTTPS listener.
extra: ACM is integrated with Elastic Load Balancing to [deploy ACM certificates on the load balancer](../facts/acm.md#acm-elb-deploys-on-load-balancer). On an instance, an ACM certificate [requires a Nitro Enclave](../facts/acm.md#acm-ec2-needs-nitro-enclave).

front: In Secrets Manager, single-user or alternating-users rotation: which one suits applications that need high availability?
extra: Alternating-users rotation suits [applications that require high availability](../facts/secrets-manager.md#secrets-manager-alternating-users-high-availability): a reader [still gets a valid set of credentials](../facts/secrets-manager.md#secrets-manager-alternating-users-high-availability).
